name: Cool Flipbook — PDF Flipbook & PDF Embedder
author: Narinder Singh

sections.description:
Cool Flipbook — PDF Flipbook & PDF Embedder is a powerful plugin that helps you show PDF files in an interactive flipbook style on your WordPress website via smart shortcode.

Simply upload a PDF, choose between page-flip and scroll viewing modes, and customize the flipbook. Once ready, copy the shortcode and add it to any WordPress page or post, so that your visitors can read PDFs directly on your website, turn pages like a real book, zoom in, and navigate between pages.

Key Features

  • Shortcode Support: Add your PDF flipbook to WordPress pages, posts, or other areas that support shortcodes. Simply copy the generated shortcode and paste it wherever you want to display it.

  • Reading Modes and Layouts: Choose between Page Flip and Scroll modes to control how visitors read your flipbook. You can also choose between single-page and double-page views.

  • Reading Directions: Choose left-to-right or right-to-left reading direction to make your flipbooks suitable for different languages and reading preferences.

  • Toolbar Controls: Choose which reading tools visitors can use, including page number, jump to page, thumbnails, table of contents, zoom, fullscreen, download, and print options. Additionally, position the toolbar at the top or bottom and choose whether it is shown, collapsed, or hidden when the flipbook opens.

  • Page Speed & Effects: Adjust the page-turn speed to control how quickly pages flip. You can also enable page shadows and adjust their strength to create a more realistic book-like reading experience.

  • Flipbook Theme: Choose between Light and Dark themes or use Auto mode to match the visitor’s device appearance settings.

  • Customization Options: Change the background and accent colors to match your website’s design. You can also enable a transparent background to blend the flipbook with your page.

  • Live Preview: Use the built-in live preview to check your changes before publishing. You can also see how your flipbook looks on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

  • Easy to Use: Designed with a user-friendly interface, making it accessible even for those with limited technical knowledge.

Use Cases

  • Product catalogs and brochures
  • E-books and guides
  • Magazines and newsletters
  • School and training materials
  • Reports and company documents
  • Menus and other PDF files

Explore More Plugins by Cool Plugins

  • Cool FormKit For Elementor Forms: Add advanced fields and features to your Elementor form widget, like conditional fields, range sliders, country code, and more.

  • Automatic Translate Addon for Loco Translate: It is a powerful addon that enhances the functionality of the Loco Translate plugin by enabling the automatic translation of WordPress themes and plugins. This addon connects with sources like Google, Yandex, DeepL, or AI-powered sources like ChatGPT, Gemini AI and Chrome AI to provide instant and automated translations.

  • AutoPoly – AI Translation For Polylang: This addon duplicates your page or post titles, content, images, galleries, or meta fields, and automatically translates them into the selected language. Whether you’re using Elementor or Gutenberg, this addon makes the translation process easier.

  • Timeline Widget For Elementor: Showcase your company history, product roadmap, and personal journey in vertical & horizontal layout directly inside Elementor.

Use of 3rd Party Services: This plugin connects to the Cool Plugins feedback server only when you choose to submit feedback while deactivating the plugin. Nothing is sent without your consent. No hidden tracking is performed, and no frontend visitor or site user data is collected. For more details, please review our Data Usage Policy, TOS, and Privacy Policy. The Flip Box block also uses Google Fonts to provide integrated typography options. When a Google font is selected in the block, the font is loaded from Google’s servers (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), which receive the visitor’s IP address. Please review Google’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Third-party libraries: This plugin includes PDF.js by Mozilla (Apache License 2.0) to display PDF files and StPageFlip by Nodlik (MIT License) to create the page-turning effect. The Flipbox feature for existing users also uses CMB2 (GPLv2 or later), Font Awesome 4.7 (SIL OFL 1.1 / MIT), jQuery Flip (MIT), imagesLoaded (MIT), fontawesome-iconpicker (MIT) and Flexbox Grid. All these libraries are included in the plugin and are not loaded from any external server or CDN.
sections.installation:
• From your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  • Search for Cool Flipbook.
  • Click Install Now, and then Activate it.
  • Next, from your dashboard go to Cool Flipbook > Add New Flipbook to create your first PDF flipbook.
  • Add a flipbook name, upload a PDF file and customize other settings.
  • Copy the shortcode from the top of the editor (it is also shown in the Shortcode column of All Flipbooks).
  • When you are happy with your changes, publish the flipbook.
  • Paste the shortcode into any page or post where you want to display your flipbook.
sections.faq:
What is Cool Flipbook?

Cool Flipbook is a WordPress plugin that lets you turn PDF files into interactive flipbooks for your visitors to flip through pages like a real book or scroll through the PDF directly on your website.

How do I create a PDF flipbook in WordPress?

After installing the plugin, go to Cool Flipbook > Add New Flipbook in your WordPress dashboard. Upload or select a PDF, customize the settings, and publish your flipbook. You can then copy its shortcode and add it to any page or post.

How do I display a flipbook on my WordPress website?

Each flipbook has its own shortcode. Copy the shortcode and paste it into a WordPress page, post, widget, or any area where you want to display the flipbook.

For example: [cfb_flipbook id=”123″]

Can I use an existing PDF from my WordPress Media Library?

Yes. You can select an existing PDF from your WordPress Media Library or upload a new PDF while creating your flipbook.

Can I display a PDF without the page-flip effect?

Yes. Cool Flipbook offers two reading modes: Page Flip and Scroll. Choose Scroll mode if you want visitors to read your PDF by scrolling instead of turning pages. Visitors can also switch between the two modes from the toolbar.

Can I display two PDF pages side by side?

Yes. You can choose between single-page and double-page layouts. You can also set when the flipbook should switch to a single-page view on smaller screens.

Can I customize the appearance of my PDF flipbook?

Yes. You can choose Light, Dark, or Auto themes, change the background and accent colors or make the background transparent, and adjust page-turn speed and shadow effects according to your preferences.

Can I open a PDF flipbook in a popup?

Yes. Cool Flipbook lets you enable the Lightbox option to open your flipbook in a popup when visitors click a button, text link, or cover image. If no cover image is set, a button is shown instead.

Can I change the reading direction of my flipbook?

Yes. You can choose left-to-right or right-to-left reading direction to suit different languages and reading preferences.

Can I customize the flipbook toolbar?

Yes. You can show or hide tools such as page number, jump to page, thumbnails, table of contents, zoom, fullscreen, download, and print. Additionally, you can also change the toolbar position and its default display.

Why is the table of contents empty?

The table of contents is built from the PDF’s own bookmarks. If your PDF has no bookmarks, the list is empty. Add bookmarks when you export the PDF, or turn the Contents button off.

Can visitors download or print the PDF?

Yes. Cool Flipbook lets you enable Download and Print buttons in the toolbar so visitors can download or print the PDF. Both buttons are off by default.

Can I preview my flipbook before publishing?

Yes. Cool Flipbook includes a live preview that lets you check your changes while customizing the flipbook. You can also preview how it looks on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Do I need coding skills to create a PDF flipbook?

No. You can create and customize PDF flipbooks using the plugin’s settings. Once your flipbook is ready, simply copy and paste its shortcode into your WordPress page or post.

I used Cool Flipbox before. Where are my Flipboxes?

They are still there. Sites that already created Flipboxes keep the Flipbox feature, the [flipboxes] shortcode, the Flipbox block and its Settings, under the Cool Flipbook menu. New installs get Flipbook only.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team help validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
